Title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
Bid Submission Type: Preferred online via iSupplier portal (https://www.dallasisd.org/domain/143). Manual paper submission in a sealed envelope delivered to Procurement Services Department (no fax or email submissions accepted).
Term of Bid: Three (3) year agreement with two (2) successive one (1) year extensions (not to exceed 5 years total).
Pre Bid Meeting: June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference. Attendance is highly encouraged but not stated as mandatory.
Installation: Required (All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, including asset decaling, asset reporting, software installation, device deployment, setup, and delivery to varied locations. Etching is strictly required on Laptops only, per Addendum 1).
Delivery Date: Dallas ISD anticipates requesting quotes for different projects from awarded vendors starting in September of 2024.
Any Additional Documentation Required: Factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications (for resellers), detailed tracking & deployment plan, Form 1295 (Certificate of Interested Parties), insurance/credit application/liability requirements (if applicable), MWBE/Subcontractor forms, pertinent literature/documentation for proposed products, signed copies of Addenda 1 and 2, and references.
MFG for Registration: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) / Factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications for resellers.
Contract or Cooperative to use: Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA) Interlocal Agreement / Title 2 of the Code of Federal Regulations (2CFR) Part 200 requirements (Federal/Local/State/Grant funds; primarily bond-funded per Addendum 1).

Bid Summary: Dallas Independent School District is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, desktops, and display monitors. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of required devices. All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services (etching is required for laptops only). The RFP is anticipated to be awarded at the August 2024 board meeting, with project quoting beginning in September 2024. The initial contract term is three years with options for two one-year renewals, and the submission deadline is extended to July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST.
